stem:
The diagram shows important structures found in a cell. Two structures, W and Z, are labeled.

Which statement **BEST** describes Structure W and Structure Z?

options.label: A
options.text: Structure W is a gene and Structure Z is a chromosome.

options.label: B
options.text: Structure W is a chromosome and Structure Z is a gene.

options.label: C
options.text: Structure W is an amino acid and Structure Z is a nucleic acid.

options.label: D
options.text: Structure W is a nucleic acid and Structure Z is an amino acid.

visual_elements: Diagram with labels W on a chromosome and Z on a DNA strand
